versions.content: The Crypto Stack shall support unique identification of cryptographic objects Status: DRAFT Description: The Crypto Stack shall assign and keep a unique identifier to any produced cryptographic artifact that can be saved or exported. Rationale: At least the unique identification of cryptographic objects is required for definition of dependencies between different objects. Also the unique identifiers can be used for general searching of concrete instances and prevention of duplication. Dependencies: – Use Case: – Supporting Material: –
